scope: read-only extended geometric diagnostics on candidates, historical e036 FNIT outputs and existing official references; not a controlled performance baseline

metric_definitions.intersection_line_overlap_mm: length of common interval of two finite triangles along their intersection line; verified using 3D edge-plane intersections
metric_definitions.white_vertices_to_pial_plane_positive_de: max signed distance of the three white triangle corners to the ordered pial face plane
metric_definitions.white_vertices_to_pial_plane_negative_de: negative of minimum signed distance to the ordered pial face plane
metric_definitions.pial_vertices_to_white_plane_positive_de: max signed distance of the three pial triangle corners to the ordered white face plane
metric_definitions.pial_vertices_to_white_plane_negative_de: negative of minimum signed distance to the ordered white face plane
metric_definitions.limits: face-plane depths are local geometric descriptors, not closest-surface distances, cortical thickness errors or interpenetration volume; contact enumeration is nonexhaustive

predicate_semantics.proper_transverse: native triangle hit AND strict straddling of both normalized planes beyond 1e-6 mm AND intersection-line overlap greater than 1e-6 mm
predicate_semantics.endpoint_edge_and_coplanar: not proper transverse; native nonproper hit counter is diagnostic, not exhaustive contact enumeration; exact same-index coincident faces reported separately
predicate_semantics.cortex: all surface pairs checked first; any-cortex subset means at least one of six triangle corners in cortex label; fully-cortex subset requires all six; neither subset excludes pairs from full-surface results
predicate_semantics.sphere_orientation: FNIT signed_sphere float32 area; outward means triangle cross dot sum of corner positions >=0 about fixed origin, threshold<0; zero/nonfinite areas separate

white_pial.scope: complete bounding sphere/bbox candidates for transverse hits; nonproper hits are native-kernel diagnostic, not exhaustive touch counting; no containment proof
